title: WordPress MCP SEO bulk update reports success but writes nothing
symptoms: Yoast title stays default and description stays empty
cause: The bulk SEO tool reports success without writing Yoast meta. The same server's live-data tool also reports no SEO plugin while Yoast is active.
fix: Write the Yoast keys through REST and confirm through yoast_head_json.
apply: GET /wp-json/wp/v2/posts/<id>?_fields=yoast_head_json and check title and description
